detail.longDescription: Tested new Ollama 0.35.0 with the tev1:0.8b decision model for fast classification and option selection, using the new /v1/systemone endpoint. Fast and efficient! Excellent! Very good addition to my Python scripts, when there’s something ambiguous you need to figure out, but you’ve got a limited set of actually available options to select from. #Ollama #LocalAI #DecisionModels #Python #SelfHosted #Automation
